compatibility.artifact_profile: Exact source bundle/archive for Cargo library dependencies plus x86_64 Linux CLI and same-toolchain development rlibs; no registry publication or stable Rust ABI claim
compatibility.pin_policy: Pin bundled commit and source/archive digest; do not substitute semver ranges or moving sibling path dependencies

host.authority: Host owns policy, domain stores, operation/result deduplication, external effects and trusted event acceptance time; effects excluded from storage CAS
host.synthetic: Twelve-command pilot catalog is FakeHost test code, not production AQ adapters

storage.layout: Whole namespace snapshot read/write plus same-transaction runtime/inspection SQL projections
storage.ownership: Session advisory locks, namespace revision CAS, backend PID and incarnation; no external service fencing after partition
storage.tls: from_client accepts host-configured synchronous postgres Client; connect convenience uses NoTls

compatibility.index_retention: Bounded persisted discovery/inspection indexes, guarded incremental GC, artifact references/disposal records and replay tombstones; unresolved work and live references refuse disposal; explicit producer epoch advances replay identity
compatibility.joins: Serial foreach; async owned children/joins provide parallelism; dynamic join-result keys have restricted downstream typing

protection.default: Absent provider rejects protected command contracts; host must reject protected root values before persistence unless provider configured
protection.optional: ProtectionKeyring uses XChaCha20-Poly1305; snapshots/artifacts encrypted with authenticated namespace/revision or digest context; missing keys/tampering fail closed
protection.keys: Host supplies keys; rotation reencryption tested; retain retired keys with backups
protection.projection: Bounded public inspection excludes raw values; opaque scheduling/scope identifiers remain metadata

compatibility.platform: Ubuntu 24.04.4 / WSL2 x86_64, rustc 1.96.1, PostgreSQL 17.11, native glibc 2.39

limits: Whole snapshot serialization and synchronous storage/host methods must stay off AQ async control handlers.
